title: double acceptance of the same offer, two sessions
expected: B blocks on A's family lock; after A commits, B fails on merit; exactly 1 acceptance
observed: B blocked on lock (timeout 57014): True; replay: SQLSTATE=P0001 ERROR:  M1C1EE: offer is not acceptable (offer_not_published); acceptances=1
note: B while-blocked error: SQLSTATE=57014 ERROR:  canceling statement due to statement timeout

title: acceptance vs concurrent request revision
expected: acceptance wins; the accepted family is closed to new request versions
observed: concurrent revision: REVISION SUCCEEDED; surviving-draft submission: SQLSTATE=P0001 ERROR:  M1C1EC: at least one request item is required on submission; post-commit revision: SQLSTATE=P0001 ERROR:  M1C1EE: a request family with a recorded acceptance is closed to new versions; acceptances=1

title: acceptance vs concurrent offer withdrawal
expected: withdrawal blocks on the acceptance's row lock, then is refused; offer ends accepted
observed: concurrent withdrawal: SQLSTATE=57014 ERROR:  canceling statement due to statement timeout; post-commit withdrawal: SQLSTATE=P0001 ERROR:  M1C1ED: terminal offers are historically frozen; final offer status=accepted

title: acceptance vs expiry transition
expected: read-time expiry refuses acceptance; the expiry transition commits; no acceptance exists
observed: A (accept past expiry): SQLSTATE=P0001 ERROR:  M1C1EE: offer is not acceptable (offer_expired); B: expiry transition committed; post-expiry accept: SQLSTATE=P0001 ERROR:  M1C1EE: offer is not acceptable (offer_not_published); acceptances=0
